title: marrubium candidissimum subsp. cylleneum
intro: Marrubium candidissimum subsp. cylleneum, commonly known as Balkan horehound, is a subspecies of perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from respiratory issues, digestive problems, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Marrubium candidissimum subsp. cylleneum include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease coughs and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
